meta.name: Count Me In
meta.description: An exhilarating celebration of the art of rock drumming, featuring some of the best drummers ever to have graced the drumkit. The viewer is taken on a uplifting journey through some of the most iconic music ever created, focusing on the women and men with the sticks, their passions, culture and awe-inspiring energy.
meta.slogan: You can have rhythm without music but you can't have music without rhythm.
